attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yedA`, a drug/metabolite exporter, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99.8% of calls at 0.20 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 open into fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 35% of calls.

**The first forks carry a parallel path.** Columns 8 to 12 hold a second branch of 5 families, `hprR` to `zinT`, carried by 11% of chromosomes, all persistent. The `fli` genes run from column 7 to column 21, [[flagellar assembly]], and the model names them in 84 to 86% of calls. At column 22 it is most hesitant, 1.56 bits, naming 61%, in a region of plasticity in 35% of calls; a second branch of 4 families, `emrE` to `insQ`, sits at columns 22 to 25.

**A long variable stretch follows.** Columns 30 to 39 run from `flagellin` at 9% to `yecU` at 88%, and columns 43 to 48 carry a second branch of 6 families, from a hypothetical protein to a DUF726 domain-containing protein, in 13 to 16% of chromosomes. The model names 88% of genes across the window at 0.51 bits, but inside a region of plasticity it names 56% against 94% outside, and hesitates 1.91 bits against 0.24.

**The window closes on forks and a final variable run.** Columns 49 to 56 carry a second branch of 8 families, from a hypothetical protein to an HsdM family class I SAM-dependent methyltransferase, in 11 to 15% of chromosomes, and columns 58 to 60 a branch of 3, from UPF0149 family protein to M48 metallopeptidase family protein. Columns 61 to 78 are variable, `cheA` to `torZ`, carried by 37 to 68% of chromosomes. The window ends at column 79, `cmoB`, in 32% of chromosomes.

label: yedA
facts:
WINDOW: the yedA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yedA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,772 to 1,851 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yedA once); 42,640 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.51 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,313 calls, named 98%, 0.19 bits; shell 9,184 calls, named 61%, 1.28 bits; cloud 1,143 calls, named 13%, 3.52 bits. Outside an RGP 35,681 calls, named 94%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 6,959 calls, named 56%, 1.91 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 32 fork, 47 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.91 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (56% against 94%); 6,959 of the 42,640 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 22 (yedK) 1.56 bits, RGP 35%; column 43 (yecA) 0.83 bits, RGP 20%; column 47 (yecR) 0.82 bits, RGP 32%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-35%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yedA "drug/metabolite exporter YedA". named 99.8%; 0.20 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-35%. named 61-99.8% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 22, named 61%, 1.56 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 8-12, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all P; the branch's families: hprR, hiuH, msrP, msrQ, zinT
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 22-25, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 14-34%, all S; the branch's families: emrE, ybcL, ybcM, insQ
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 43-48, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-16%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "site-specific integrase", "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", "DUF2787 family protein", "DUF726 domain-containing protein"
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 49-56, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-15%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "DNA polymerase", "hypothetical protein", "helix-turn-helix transcriptional regula…", "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase", "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", "HsdM family class I SAM-dependent methy…"
